turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have until then. Owen found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of a class, nobody called me, and I'd like to know why.
That's not an answer. Why did nobody call me before that zero went in?
The file was created at 11:31 PM. 612 words appeared at 11:52 PM and 794 more at 11:58 PM.

"Eleven thirty-one," "six hundred and twelve words at eleven fifty-two," "seven hundred and ninety-four at eleven fifty-eight." What night, and where is that written down, because I'm not taking times from your memory. And you still haven't told me why nobody called me.
How long after the file was created did the first words appear?
You're leading me, Hale, and I don't do your arithmetic for you. Show me the document with the date on it, or we're going upstairs.
What time is it now, by the way?
Just about twenty past four, which is less time than you think. The document, Hale.
